speaker: Alexis (Kid)
line: (opening a box) My very first phone! I’m finally a real middle schooler.

speaker: Alexis (Kid)
line: (phone buzzes) Ooh, I got a text! Ooh, what if it's Harry Styles?!

speaker: Alexis (Kid)
line: “Roblox: Congrats! You won 10,000 free Robux. Claim them in 10 minutes or they’re gone: roblox-rewards.co”

speaker: Alexis (Kid)
line: Ten thousand Robux?! I’ve never won anything!

speaker: Alexis (Kid)
line: (tapping) It just needs my username and password to send them. Easy!

speaker: Brendan (Pawnzy)
line: (swooping in) Stooop! Don’t type that in!

speaker: Alexis (Kid)
line: Whoa! Who are you?

speaker: Brendan (Pawnzy)
line: I’m Pawnzy. I used to be a scammer. I sent texts exactly like that one.

speaker: Alexis (Kid)
line: Wait, you’re a scammer?! Is that why you wear a mask?

speaker: Brendan (Pawnzy)
line: That’s just my face. I’m a raccoon. But when my niece got scammed, I saw how much it hurt, and I quit. Now I teach kids how to spot scams and stay safe from them.

speaker: Alexis (Kid)
line: But it says Roblox. Roblox is real.

speaker: Brendan (Pawnzy)
line: Roblox is real, but that text isn’t from them. Trust me, I used to write those. Roblox says there’s no such thing as free Robux.

speaker: Alexis (Kid)
line: But it says I only have ten minutes!

speaker: Brendan (Pawnzy)
line: That’s the oldest trick in my old book. Rush people so they don’t stop and think.

speaker: Alexis (Kid)
line: What would they even do with my password?

speaker: Brendan (Pawnzy)
line: They’d log in as you and take your account, plus everything you’ve got in it.

speaker: Alexis (Kid)
line: So what should I do?

speaker: Brendan (Pawnzy)
line: Don’t tap the link, and never share your password. Show a grown-up instead.

speaker: Alexis (Kid)
line: Phew! I almost lost my account on my very first day with a phone.

speaker: Brendan (Pawnzy)
line: You’re not the only one. Texts like that go out every single day.
